about: Hand-made corrections to ExitSides.json (wrong or missing OpenStreetMap data), in its format: a station with name, lat, lon, optionally ril100 (DB code) and uic (EVA number), and its tracks. A track here replaces the generated one of the same number at that station (matched by ril100, else uic, else name within 1 km); a station the generated list lacks is added. heading: compass degrees (0 north, 90 east) of a train for which side holds; the other way round it is the other side. terminal: a buffer stop lies ahead on heading, so every arriving train travels on it. `example` is ignored by the app.
